Embedded analytics in every process, no parallel systems.
Modern, role-based user experience with SAP Fiori.

categories.title: Designed for your industry
categories.intro: Cover the specific needs of industries like transportation, maintenance, manufacturing, agribusiness, retail and distribution.

items.name: Credit Card Operator Reconciliation
items.shortDesc: Automates reconciliation of Transbank or Getnet deposits against your card sales.
items.fullDesc: The Credit Card reconciliation add-on is essential for companies operating with Transbank or Getnet. It automates the reconciliation of deposits received against card payments from sales recorded in SAP Business One. The solution imports settlement files, performing an intelligent match between the amounts deposited by the operator and the sales payments received (credit/debit). This lets you automatically post the fees and withholdings applied, ensuring the accounting balance matches the real balance. It eliminates manual reconciliation work, guarantees accuracy and significantly speeds up the financial close.

items.name: Warehouse Management (WMS) — Produmex
items.shortDesc: Storage rules, efficient picking and mobile scanning for your warehouses.
items.fullDesc: Produmex WMS and Produmex Scan offer an advanced solution to optimize warehouse management in SAP Business One. Produmex WMS provides the business intelligence to implement complex storage rules, optimize the use of locations and define high-efficiency picking strategies. Produmex Scan is the mobile component that lets warehouse operators run every product-handling task, from receiving and cycle counting to final dispatch, using mobile scanning devices. This eliminates paper, drastically reduces inventory errors and ensures precise traceability of every item.

items.name: Apparel & Footwear
items.shortDesc: Size and color product matrix for fashion, footwear and apparel.
items.fullDesc: The Apparel & Footwear add-on complements SAP Business One to meet the complex needs of fashion, footwear and apparel companies managing multiple product variants. Its main function is to replace individual item management with an intuitive Product Matrix (styles), allowing quick product creation based on attributes like color and size, greatly simplifying data entry. It makes inventory management easier by letting you view and control stock for every variant combination on a single screen. It also optimizes purchasing, sales and production processes with specialized tools, such as collection planning, season-based procurement and size/color order management.

items.name: Mobile One
items.shortDesc: Turns every salesperson into a mobile office: catalog, pricing, stock and field sales.
items.fullDesc: Mobile One is an app designed to extend SAP Business One's functionality to your field sales team. Its goal is to turn every salesperson into a mobile office, eliminating paperwork and double data entry. The add-on provides real-time access to critical information from a sales terminal: product catalog, customer-specific price lists and up-to-date inventory levels. Salespeople can create sales receipts or invoices directly at the point of sale, with automatic stock validation, register payment and generate the electronic sales document. All sales data is integrated into SAP Business One instantly and accurately.

items.name: Enterpryze
items.shortDesc: A mobile, cloud suite that brings SAP Business One to every employee, in and out of the office.
items.fullDesc: Enterpryze is a suite of modular, mobile, cloud-based applications designed to extend SAP Business One's functionality to every employee at your company, especially those working outside the office. It acts as a friendly bridge between SAP Business One's complexity and end users, with an intuitive interface for specific tasks. Its goal is to improve productivity in the field and ensure that all operations and data are captured and synced in real time.
features: Mobile sales & CRM — Customer data, live inventory, orders and quotes from any device.
Field service management — Work orders, technician assignment, time tracking and customer signature.
Expense & finance management — Capture and approval of travel expenses from the phone's camera.
Operations & inventory — Mobile cycle-counting and transfer functions.

items.name: Farm4all — Agricultural Management
items.shortDesc: Full traceability and precise costs by product, batch, field block or season.
items.fullDesc: Farm4all is a specialized add-on that integrates the operational and financial management of the agricultural and agribusiness sector directly with SAP Business One. It incorporates the complex logic of crop cycles and field production. Its goal is to ensure full production traceability and precise unit-cost calculation by product, batch, field block or season, with constant monitoring and real-time budget control.
features: Campaigns & field blocks — Planning and budget control by agricultural campaign and land unit.
Agricultural work orders — Sowing, irrigation, fertilizing and pruning, with labor, machinery and input costs.
Inventory traceability — From inputs (seeds, agrochemicals) to harvest records.
Financial integration — Field costs are automatically posted to SAP Business One's accounting.

categories.title: Horizontal, for any industry
categories.intro: Solutions that enhance the standard modules (Finance, Inventory, Sales) and apply to virtually any industry.

items.name: Electronic Invoicing — Issuance
items.shortDesc: Issue, stamp and send every tax document in compliance with SII regulations.
items.fullDesc: The Electronic Invoicing solution for SAP Business One manages the full tax-document cycle in compliance with Chilean regulations (SII). It automates the issuance, stamping and sending of every Electronic Tax Document (DTE) — invoices, credit notes, debit notes, receipts and dispatch guides — directly from sales documents in SAP Business One.

items.name: Electronic Invoicing — Automatic Receipt
items.shortDesc: Receives and validates your suppliers' invoices and creates purchase drafts on its own.
items.fullDesc: Streamlines the purchasing cycle by automatically integrating supplier invoices. It receives the XML files, automatically validates them with the SII and efficiently creates purchase document drafts in SAP Business One. This eliminates manual data entry, reduces operational errors and ensures tax traceability and real-time financial control.

items.name: Fixed Asset Tax Adjustment
items.shortDesc: Automatic monetary correction of fixed assets per SII (CPI) regulations.
items.fullDesc: The Monetary Correction add-on for SAP Business One's Fixed Asset module is essential for accounting compliance under Chilean (SII) regulations. It automatically calculates and adjusts asset values and accumulated depreciation based on official price indexes (like the CPI), generating correction journal entries in bulk and on a periodic basis. It ensures balance sheets reflect the real economic value of assets.

items.name: Bank Statement Import
items.shortDesc: Imports bank statements and speeds up reconciliation with intelligent matching.
items.fullDesc: Eliminates manual entry of bank account movements in SAP Business One. It enables direct, automated import of bank transactions from multiple formats (CSV, TXT) into the treasury module, and performs intelligent matching of bank movements against recorded payments and deposits. It reduces errors and ensures balances reflect the real daily cash position.

items.name: Payment File Generation
items.shortDesc: Generates the consolidated payment file in the format your bank requires.
items.fullDesc: Automates the treasury process in SAP Business One by generating a consolidated payment file (suppliers, payroll or services) in the structured, secure format your bank requires. It takes transactions from the treasury module and generates a flat file ready for direct upload to the bank portal. It eliminates manual entry for each payment and speeds up the treasury cycle.

items.name: Daily Exchange Rate Update
items.shortDesc: Automatically updates official exchange rates from the Central Bank.
items.fullDesc: A service for managing SAP Business One's daily exchange rates across currencies. It automates the reliable daily load of official values directly from the Central Bank. It connects, downloads the day's rate and updates the Exchange Rate table. It eliminates manual entry errors and ensures every foreign-currency transaction and report reflects accurate values.

categories.title: Make SAP fit your process
categories.intro: Tools that customize, automate and connect SAP Business One so it fits your company's processes, not the other way around.

items.name: Boyum Usability Package (B1UP)
items.shortDesc: The most popular add-on to customize and automate SAP Business One with no development.
items.fullDesc: Boyum Usability Package (B1UP) is the most popular and versatile add-on to customize, automate and improve the user experience in SAP Business One. It provides a toolset that lets you adapt SAP Business One without development, so it fits your company's specific processes.
features: Screen customization — Redesign any form: required fields, hide tabs or change the layout.
Automation & function buttons — Buttons that run a sequence of actions or business logic in one click.
Rules & validations — Advanced business rules and data validations to ensure information quality.
Productivity tools — Bulk data updates and utilities for day-to-day data handling.

items.name: Intercompany
items.shortDesc: Automatically replicates master data and transactions between your subsidiaries or companies.
items.fullDesc: An ideal solution for companies with multiple subsidiaries or companies running separate SAP Business One databases. It automates the replication of master data and transactions between them: when Company A issues a sales invoice, it automatically creates the vendor invoice in Company B. It eliminates double entry, speeds up internal settlement and makes financial consolidation and cross-entity inventory management easier.

items.name: MyWave.ai
items.shortDesc: Artificial intelligence and advanced analytics on top of your SAP Business One data.
items.fullDesc: myWave.ai is an Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Analytics platform designed to power decision-making based on SAP Business One data. It enhances SAP Business One with AI-driven processes and smart integration between systems, simplifying complex operations and helping you scale your business.
features: Smart processes — Reduces repetitive tasks, increases efficiency and improves regulatory compliance.
Customer personalization — Adapts processes based on customer data and improves engagement.
Natural language — Natural-language commands for SAP Business One processes.
Real-time decisions — Real-time data to respond quickly to market changes.
Data security — Encryption and access control to protect your confidential information.

items.name: Processes
items.shortDesc: Billing automations that save your admin team time.
items.fullDesc: Automations over the invoicing flow in SAP Business One to eliminate repetitive tasks.
features: Bulk invoice creation.
Invoice creation from sales orders.

categories.title: Connect SAP with the apps you already use
categories.intro: DOT Conector is a powerful, easy-to-use integration platform that connects SAP Business One with a wide range of third-party applications and data sources. It lets non-technical users enable two-way communication between SAP Business One and external systems (e-commerce, marketplaces, WMS, TMS, CRM, payment processors, etc.), eliminating manual tasks and speeding up your order-to-cash cycle.

items.name: Rindegastos
items.shortDesc: Automates the reporting and management of travel expenses.
items.fullDesc: The Rindegastos integration with SAP Business One automates expense reporting and management. It centralizes receipt digitization by employees. Once validated and approved in Rindegastos, they're automatically transferred to SAP Business One, creating the corresponding accounting documents (journal entries or vendor invoices), respecting cost centers and accounts. It eliminates manual entry and speeds up the payment process.

items.name: Payroll
items.shortDesc: Accounting close of the payroll process, integrated into SAP Business One.
items.fullDesc: The integration of payroll platforms with SAP Business One automates the accounting close of the payroll process. Once payroll is processed, it generates and transfers a consolidated journal entry to SAP Business One, detailing expenses, provisions and accounts payable per your chart of accounts. It eliminates double entry and speeds up the monthly close.

items.name: TMS · Transportation Management
items.shortDesc: Route optimization and delivery tracking connected to your orders.
items.fullDesc: The TMS integration with SAP Business One automates distribution management. posts.title: SAP Business One or S/4HANA: how to know which one your company needs
posts.excerpt: Size, complexity and growth define the right ERP. We explain when each one makes sense, without over-investing.

body.text: Choosing an ERP isn't about picking «the biggest one», but the one that fits how your company operates today and where it wants to go. In practice, the decision between SAP Business One and SAP S/4HANA comes down to three variables: the size and complexity of your operation, transaction volume and growth projection.

left.title: SAP Business One
left.text: Built for small and mid-sized companies that need to integrate finance, sales, inventory, purchasing and production on a single platform, with a fast implementation and a predictable total cost. It's the core that most retail and hospitality businesses build their operation on.

right.title: SAP S/4HANA
right.text: Comes into play when the organization reaches a scale and complexity, multiple entities, very high transaction volume, processes that demand real-time analytics, that justify an enterprise platform. It isn't «the better version» of Business One: it's a tool for a different problem.

body.text: Our advice is simple: don't over-size. A well-implemented Business One supports years of growth, and migrating to S/4HANA makes sense when the business genuinely calls for it.

posts.title: Unified commerce: one core for store, e-commerce and mobile sales
posts.excerpt: When every channel runs on the same SAP core, stock, customers and finances always reconcile. Here's what unified commerce looks like in practice.

body.text: Multichannel isn't the same as unified. Many retailers sell in-store, on e-commerce and on marketplaces, but each channel lives in its own system: stock drifts out of sync, the customer is duplicated and financial reconciliation becomes a monthly headache.

left.title: Multichannel
left.text: Each channel lives in its own system: stock drifts out of sync, the customer is duplicated and financial reconciliation becomes a monthly headache.

right.title: Unified commerce
right.text: A single core, SAP Business One, beneath every channel. Point of sale, the online store, mobile sales and loyalty all read and write against the same source of truth: one inventory, one customer, one set of books.

body.text: The payoff, in the operation

items: Reliable stock promises
Ship-from-nearest-store
Consistent prices and promotions across channels
Financial close without parallel spreadsheets

body.text: The customer experiences one brand, not five disconnected systems.

You don't have to replace everything at once. The usual path is to consolidate the ERP core and POS first, then add e-commerce, mobile sales and loyalty on top of that base. Every channel you integrate adds value without breaking what already works.

posts.title: Electronic invoicing (DTE) in Chile: what your operation must have solved
posts.excerpt: From the tax authority to your customers, without friction. What the electronic tax document rules require and how to automate them inside your ERP.

body.text: In Chile, issuing electronic tax documents (DTE), invoices, receipts, credit and debit notes, isn't optional: it's how the tax authority (SII) requires companies to operate. The question is no longer «whether» to invoice electronically, but how integrated and reliable that process is inside your operation.

left.title: Isolated tools
left.text: Documents issued outside the ERP, folios that fall out of sync, and manual reconciliation between what was sold and what was declared. Every manual step is an opportunity for error before the SII.

right.title: DTE inside the ERP
right.text: The document is generated automatically from the sale, at the point of sale or in Business One, and reaches the customer and the SII with no manual intervention, full traceability and folios that always reconcile.

body.text: For a high-volume retail or hospitality operation, that automation is the difference between a calm tax close and a race against the clock every month. It's also the foundation to scale: more stores and more channels without adding administrative work.

posts.title: DOT's gastronomy ecosystem: what it's made of and how you build it
posts.excerpt: Eight pieces covering the floor, the kitchen, delivery, purchasing and loyalty on one shared data core. Take them all, or start with just one.

body.text: In a restaurant, software doesn't break at the register: it breaks at the edges. In the delivery order someone re-types by hand, in the shrinkage that shows up at month-end. An ecosystem is a set of pieces that already talk to each other, on one shared data core.
That way, what happens in the kitchen, at the register and in delivery is one single story, not five systems you have to reconcile by hand.
The eight pieces

items: Business One — ERP and accounting
TCPOS — Point of sale
Smart Order — Purchasing and stock
ChefCloud — Delivery
AyHungry — Reservations and service
Loyalty — Loyalty program
BiPyxis — Business Intelligence
DTE — Electronic invoicing

body.text: Every line is a native integration: data flows between the pieces on its own, with no re-typing.
How you build it
You can take the full ecosystem or start with a single piece. Neither is more correct — it depends on where you are today.
The full ecosystem makes sense when opening a new operation or replacing a system that no longer holds up: everything arrives pre-integrated, with a single owner accountable for it working.
Piece by piece is the more common path. Start with whatever hurts the most today; each piece works on its own, and the next one arrives already connected — no integration project in between.

items: If the problem is delivery on tablets → ChefCloud.
If it's shrinkage and plate cost → Smart Order.
If it's the line at peak hour → AyHungry.
If you don't know which location left margin on the table → BiPyxis.

body.text: Already have an ERP? The ecosystem is built on SAP Business One, but it also integrates with whatever your company already uses.

A date to know: starting November 1, 2026, the electronic dispatch guides and invoices that support the movement of goods must include transport data. If you run a central kitchen or move inventory between locations, the system issuing the document needs to capture those fields.
In short

items: Eight pieces on one shared core, with SAP Business One at the center.
You can take them all, or start with just one.
Each one works on its own; adding the next isn't an integration project.

body.text: DOT Solutions has been implementing this ecosystem for more than 18 years, with over 300 clients across 8 countries in Latin America.

posts.title: DOT's retail ecosystem: what it's made of and how you build it
posts.excerpt: Eight pieces that share the same stock, the same price and the same customer. Take them all, or start with one and keep adding.

body.text: An ecosystem isn't a bundle of products with a discount. It's a set of pieces that already talk to each other: they share one data core, so stock, price and the customer are the same in-store, on e-commerce and on mobile sales.
That's the difference: nothing to integrate, and no one to call when the problem falls between two systems.
